Learn more about us

More offices, more access

Whether you’re close to home or out of town, you can visit any Pediatric Associates location in the region for care.

Learn more

All-in-one care

We deliver top-quality care that focuses on whole-child health with in-house laboratory services, X-rays, and more.

Learn more

Virtual visits

Not every health concern needs a trip to the doctor’s office. With the KidzDocNow app, your child can see a pediatrician with a video appointment right from the comfort of home.

Learn more

After hours & weekend visits

We’re here for the sniffles, fevers, and “uh-oh” moments—even on evenings and weekends.

Trusted care from day one

From the very first moments after birth, we’re here to be your child’s medical home through every stage of growing up—all the way to age 21. At Pediatric Associates, you and your child will always feel welcome, comfortable, and cared for like family.

your medical home

A comprehensive resource for vaccines in 2026

Keeping your children safe is top priority, but the new schedule changes can be complex. Vaxfacts.info provides concise, pediatrician-supported clarity from our nationwide network of pediatricians and can help you make informed decisions on your child’s vaccine schedule.
